requirements.requirement: The system must include an 'explainability' field in the FastAPI JSON response when the Evaluate Care endpoint is invoked.
The system must ensure the 'explainability' field contains an array of measure-level objects matching the schema defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-ST-001.
The system must propagate the explainability payload from evaluate_care_facade.py through main.py without transformation or data loss.
The system must update the tool_router response contract to include the explainability field in tool outputs.
The system must ensure backward compatibility by returning a valid response even if the client does not consume the explainability field.
The system must return explainability data only when scoring results are present in the response.
The system must return an empty explainability array if no measure-level data is available from the facade.
The system must return a 500 error response if the explainability payload cannot be serialized into valid JSON.
The system must log an error when the explainability payload is missing despite successful scoring execution.
The system must ensure the explainability payload structure is deterministic and consistent across identical requests.
The system must ensure that LLM-facing tool responses include the explainability payload in a structured, non-freeform JSON format.
The system must prevent the LLM from altering or hallucinating explainability values by only passing through backend-generated data.
The system must ensure the explainability payload is accessible to downstream chat rendering logic without additional parsing beyond standard JSON decoding.
The system must include all required fields (measure_id, raw_value, normalized_score, weight, contribution_to_final_score) in each explainability object returned via the API.
